note: BV NR467 Pt B rule tables. The corrosion table here is the fore workbook's own abridgement of Ch 4 Sec 3 Tab 1 and it does NOT match the deckhouse workbook's abridgement: the names differ ('sea water' vs 'seawater') and this one carries a 'weather deck exposed' entry at 1.7 mm that the deckhouse table has no equivalent for. They are kept separate deliberately rather than merged, so each module reproduces its own source; reconcile them against the rule text before sharing one table. The corrosion table has been removed from this file: Ch 4 Sec 3 Tab 1 is now read once from the rule into app/data/corrosion.json and shared. What this workbook had is recorded in build/fore_expected.json.
